title: MemForm: Benchmarking Memory Formation Poisoning in LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.14431v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Long-term memory enables LLM agents to learn from past interactions but exposes memory formation to adversarial influence. Existing studies primarily organize memory poisoning by attack channels, corruption patterns, or lifecycle stages, leaving formation interfaces insufficiently characterized. We formulate Memory Formation Poisoning as adversarial manipulation of the interfaces through which persistent agent memory is produced and committed, and introduce MemForm, a controlled diagnostic benchmark covering five interfaces: Content, Evidence, Scope, Selection, and Path Poisoning. We introduce Selection and Path Poisoning as controlled intervention categories that isolate retention and consolidation order effects, respectively. Each category pairs clean and poisoned conditions with interface-specific controls. translated_title: MemForm：LLM智能体中的记忆形成投毒基准测试
translated_abstract: 长期记忆使LLM智能体能够从过去的交互中学习，但也使记忆形成过程暴露于对抗性影响之下。现有研究主要按攻击通道、破坏模式或生命周期阶段来组织记忆投毒，而对记忆形成界面的刻画不足。我们将“记忆形成投毒”形式化为对持久性智能体记忆的产生与提交接口的对抗性操纵，并引入MemForm——一个受控诊断基准，涵盖五种界面：内容投毒、证据投毒、范围投毒、选择投毒和路径投毒。我们提出选择投毒与路径投毒作为受控干预类别，分别用于隔离保留效应与巩固顺序效应。每个类别都将干净条件与被投毒条件配对，并配有界面特定的控制措施。在六个大语言模型和两种响应格式上的评估显示，所有五种界面均存在广泛的易感性。
tldr: 该论文提出MemForm基准，将LLM智能体的记忆形成投毒形式化为对记忆产生与提交界面的对抗性操纵，首次引入选择投毒与路径投毒两种干预类别，并揭示六种主流大模型在全部五种界面上均存在广泛易感性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MemForm, a controlled diagnostic benchmark that formulates memory formation poisoning in LLM agents as adversarial manipulation of memory production and commit interfaces—covering Content, Evidence, Scope, Selection, and Path Poisoning—and reveals broad susceptibility across six LLMs at all five interfaces.
